# [PR #3229] [JIT] Add missing uint64 argument type mappings

source: https://github.com/tile-ai/tilelang/pull/3229
state: closed | updated: 2026-09-17T09:57:56Z
labels: 

## 正文

Add missing uint64 mappings for Cython and NVRTC arguments.
Fixes #2988.

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

## Summary

Adds `uint64` support to Cython and NVRTC host wrappers.

- Maps CUDA `uint64` arguments to `uint64_t`.
- Maps Cython tensor arguments to `ctypes.c_uint64`.
- Maps NVRTC arguments to `ctypes.c_uint64`.
- Adds CUDA-gated tests for `uint64` tensor arithmetic and scalar arguments across Cython, NVRTC, and `tvm_ffi`.
- Fixes the `Unsupported dtype uint64` compile-time failure.

## Testing

Test execution results are not available.
